Private QUIC state, packet handling, callbacks, and helper functions.

# Purpose
This header file defines private data structures, constants, and internal helper functions for the QUIC implementation. It declares the internal `fd_quic_state_private` layout, packet and frame context types, and helper accessors such as [`fd_quic_get_state`](<#fd_quic_get_state>) and [`fd_quic_conn_at_idx`](<#fd_quic_conn_at_idx>). It also declares connection management, TLS callback entry points, packet handling functions, ACK and RTT helpers, and callback wrappers used by the QUIC core. The file includes internal pool and list templates for TLS handshake objects and sets private configuration values such as `FD_QUIC_MAGIC`, packet number markers, and the optional `FD_QUIC_DISABLE_CRYPTO` test flag.
